admin.title: Pages
admin.subtitle: Editable content pages (imprint, terms, privacy) with per-language versions.
admin.slugHelp: The part after the slash (technical term: “slug”) — lowercase, e.g. imprint becomes /imprint. Cannot be changed later.
admin.markdownHint: Safe Markdown subset: **bold**, *italic*, `code`, [link](/path), lists (- / 1.), > quotes, ``` code blocks. Anything else shows up as plain text on the page.
admin.previewHint: This is how the content looks on the public page.
admin.bodyTooLong: Text too long: {count} of at most {max} characters. Please shorten it.
admin.bodyTooLongHint: Shorten the text or split it across a second page — nothing was saved.
admin.templateHint: This page does not exist in your community yet — until it does, visitors read this default text. Saving creates it, and from then on it is yours: change, cut and add whatever you like.
admin.savedHint: Saved the “{language}” version — other languages are saved from their own tab.
admin.saveFailedHint: Your text is still in the editor. Check your connection and save again.
admin.deleteFailedHint: The page is still there. Reload the list and try again.
admin.confirmDeleteText: “{slug}” disappears with all its language versions — links to it will break.
admin.loadFailedHint: The editor stayed empty — saving from here would overwrite the existing content. Check your connection and open the page again.
admin.titleRequiredHint: Every language version has its own title — enter it in the active tab.
admin.translatedHint: It is not saved and not published yet — read it through, change what needs changing, then save.
admin.translateFailedHint: Please try again in a moment. If it keeps failing, translate the text by hand.
admin.translateTooLong: Too long for a suggestion (up to {max} characters) — this text belongs in human hands.

draftNotice.title: Draft, under review by our lawyers
draftNotice.body: This page carries the required structure, but no binding text yet. The reviewed version will replace it before branding.supply opens to everyone. Until then: nothing here is something you can rely on.

validation.translateBodyMax: Text is too long for a translation suggestion

navigation.title: Navigation
navigation.description: Decide what appears in your community’s menu, in which order, and under which name.

empty.title: Nothing to arrange yet
empty.description: As soon as your community offers products or published pages, they show up here.

navigation.orphanHint: Shows as a main entry because “{label}” is hidden.
navigation.groupHint: A drop-down only — this entry has no page of its own.
navigation.groupEmptyHint: Appears once it has a sub-entry.
navigation.outdent: Turn back into a main entry
navigation.errorSave: The menu could not be saved.
navigation.errorUnknownPage: One of your links points to a page that does not exist here.

link.kindGroup: A main entry without a page of its own

preview.title: Preview
preview.description: This is the order visitors will see. Main entries beyond the fifth move into a “More” menu.

validation.notRetargetable: Built-in entries can be renamed, but not pointed somewhere else. Add your own link instead.
validation.groupNoTarget: A main entry without a page of its own cannot have a target. Add your own link instead.
validation.parentInvalid: A sub-entry needs a main entry from the same list — and sub-entries of a sub-entry do not exist.
validation.labelRequired: Please give the link a name
validation.targetRequired: Please choose where the link goes
validation.externalInvalid: External links must start with https://
validation.internalInvalid: That is not a valid page address
validation.tooMany: That is more entries than a menu can hold
validation.tooLarge: The menu is too large. Please use shorter names or fewer entries.

seo.title: Search listing
seo.description: Decide how your community shows up in search engines — and whether it should show up at all.
seo.errorSave: The search listing could not be saved.

field.label: Description of your home page
field.placeholder: In one or two sentences: what is this about?
field.hint: This text appears below the title in a search result.
field.usingExcerpt: Empty: the first paragraph of your home page is used.
field.noneAtAll: Empty and no home page: the search result shows no description at all.

noindex.label: Keep this community out of search engines
noindex.description: Search engines are asked not to list the community in their results.
noindex.delayTitle: Takes effect the next time a search engine visits
noindex.delayText: Pages that are already listed do not disappear right away. It can take days or weeks until a search engine comes back.
noindex.notPrivate: This does not make the community private: anyone with the link still gets in. For that, use the members-only setting under General.

preview.title: Preview
preview.description: This is how your listing looks when someone finds it or shares your link.
preview.hiddenNote: While the switch above is on, this listing is not meant to appear at all.
preview.socialGenerated: This card is generated automatically from your community colour and name.
preview.socialOffText: Preview cards are not enabled on this instance. Shared links appear without an image.

redirects.title: Redirects
redirects.description: When you rename or move a page, old links break. Here you say where they should lead instead.
redirects.errorSave: The redirects could not be saved.
redirects.empty: Add an old address and its new target above.
redirects.footnote: A redirect applies to exactly this one address — there are no wildcards. The stored path also catches the German version, and for a target on this site the language is preserved. Query parameters travel along.

add.title: Add a redirect
add.hint: Old address as a path, for example /about. The target is either a path on this site or a full https address.
add.full: More than {max} redirects are not possible.

validation.fromMax: The old address is too long.
validation.fromInvalid: This cannot be used as an old address: it must be a path starting with /, and it must not be an area the platform needs for itself (sign-in, administration, home page).
validation.internalInvalid: The target must be a path on this site and start with /.
validation.externalInvalid: A target on another site must start with https://.
validation.duplicateFrom: There is already a redirect for this old address.
validation.chain: A target must not itself appear as an old address in this list — otherwise visitors are redirected twice in a row, or a loop is created.
validation.tooLarge: The list is too long overall.

public.otherLanguage: This page is not available in {requested} yet — showing the {delivered} version.
